candidates.name: TimeseriesML (TSML)
verified_facts: TimeseriesML defines an XML encoding for the OGC Timeseries Profile of Observations and Measurements.
Its purpose is interoperable exchange of time-series data sets across information systems.
semantic_limits: A standards-compliant time-series encoding does not validate the sensor, survey, datum, raster lineage or uncertainty of values carried inside it.

candidates.name: network Common Data Form (netCDF) standards suite
verified_facts: The OGC netCDF suite supports encoding geospatial information representing space- and time-varying phenomena as related multidimensional arrays.
CF metadata conventions describe what variables represent and their spatial and temporal properties.
semantic_limits: Array structure and descriptive metadata do not establish source survey accuracy, bare-earth semantics, vertical datum or parcel-specific provenance.
